goal: Make reusable handoff/provenance verifier retrieval intrinsically immutable without weakening read-only authority semantics.
required_invariants: verifier_ref must be a 40-character commit SHA
no mutable default branch/tag may select verifier code
downloaded executable/config content must be commit-bound or digest-verified
workflow success remains evidence only and does not become execution/admissibility/custody authority
all adopted callers must be revalidated after successor contract installation
